emitStates()

The emitStates() method registers observational state emit callbacks on a FeatureCell. Emit-state callbacks execute after a finalized StateSnapshotShape has been committed and exposed through the FeatureCell’s state surfaces.

Method Contract Summary

  • Emit-state callbacks are registered declaratively on a FeatureCell instance
  • Callbacks execute after state commitment and exposure
  • Callbacks receive the finalized StateSnapshotShape<T>
  • Callbacks must be observational only
  • Callback execution does not influence state commitment

The emitStates() method defines post-commit observation only. It does not derive state, does not modify state, does not influence pipeline execution, and does not participate in state commitment.

Note

The emitStates() method is additive. It may be invoked multiple times, and each invocation overwrites previously registered emit-state callbacks. Callbacks execute in the exact order they are registered during initialization.

Emit-state callbacks must be registered before initialize().

Core Emit State Behavior
Example

The emitStates() method registers one or more observational callbacks that receive the finalized StateSnapshotShape after state commitment.

What this does

  • Registers one or more observational callbacks on the FeatureCell
  • Callbacks receive the finalized StateSnapshotShape
  • Callbacks execute after state commitment
  • Callback execution does not modify state or influence execution

This demonstrates the intended use of emitStates() as a declarative post-commit observation surface.

Example: Registering Emit-State Callbacks

{{`
// The provideFeatureCell key must match the @FeatureCell key input
          
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { FeatureCell, injectVault } from '@sdux-vault/angular';
import { Employee } from './employee.shape';

@FeatureCell<Employee[]>('employees')
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class EmployeeService {

  // Use injectVault to get an instance of the FeatureCell
  readonly vault = injectVault<Employee[]>(EmployeeService);

  constructor() {
    // Required to activate the FeatureCell
    this.vault.emitStates(
        [
          (snapshot) => {
            console.info('Snapshot committed:', snapshot.value);
          }
        ]
      )
      .initialize();
  }
}`}}
 
{{`export const employeeCell = FeatureCell({
  key: 'employees',
  initialState: []
});

// Initialization the FeatureCell 
employeeCell
  .emitStates(
    [
      (snapshot) => {
        console.info('Snapshot committed:', snapshot.value);
      }
    ]
  )
  .initialize();`}}
